submitted.rationale: XRD shows single-phase BiSbO4 at Sb ≥ 0.51 (idx 21, 27). At higher Bi content there is also a mixture with a Bi-rich phase (Q≈1.99, 2.31, 3.26, 3.83 Å⁻¹), and that phase grows as Bi increases. EQE peaked in the mixed-phase region at idx 15 (Bi0.70Sb0.30): 0.0058%. That is about 1.9× the phase-pure BiSbO4 (idx 21: 0.0030%) and higher than the more Bi-rich idx 11 (0.0033%).
